description: Search Google's product taxonomy — the set of valid googleProductCategory values. Returns ranked category paths with their numeric ids, plus whether the query itself is already a valid category (full path or id). Use it to find the right category for a product type, to fix unmatched entries from map_categories, or to check a value before writing it into a rule.

query.description: Free text ("sofa bed"), a full path, or a numeric category id.

name: search_taxonomy
title: Search Google taxonomy
